points: Type IVd reaction: drug-specific T cells release **IL-8 (CXCL8)**, recruiting neutrophils into the epidermis.
Latency **under 48 hours** for antibiotics; up to 1–2 weeks for some drugs.
IL36RN variants overlap with generalised pustular psoriasis.
Pinhead pustules on erythema, starting in the **flexures and face** and becoming generalised; burning or itch.
Fever above 38 °C; neutrophilia; mild organ involvement in up to 20%.

items.t: Widespread pustules within days of an antibiotic: **same-day dermatology**.
Mucosal erosions, skin sloughing or systemic organ dysfunction: hospital.

pearls.t: AGEP has the **shortest latency** of the severe drug reactions (hours to 2 days).

quiz.q: Name a red flag that needs escalation.
quiz.a: Widespread pustules within days of an antibiotic: **same-day dermatology**.
